details.note: Six fixed duration profiles (one reference plus five LCG profiles from seed 20261023, each duration 20-200 in steps of 10) crossed with four verdict outcomes. The inaccurate-severity stress regime was added after inspecting initial results, so its pooled average is exploratory and weighted equally by design, not a population estimate. Virtual time models current allSettled batches, not wall-clock latency. Every strategy receives the same DAG, durations, severity inputs, and failure node. Primary baseline is parallel FIFO with full rerun.

sameEstimatorBudgetCheck.note: Internal consistency only: the full selector uses this exact heuristic to decide fit.

details.note: 27 prespecified order/content/budget cases. Full-text retention is a format measure, not answer quality; a summary can be sufficient. Proxy overruns are checked with the same heuristic used by the selector, so zero for the full method is an internal invariant, not independent validation. No model tokenizer or measured context overflow is used. Fixed-threshold ablation caps evidence at 180 tokens while respecting smaller scenario budgets. Summaries are adapter-supplied fixture inputs whose factual fidelity is assumed here.
